mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with wage inflation and can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST < 1,000,000 and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 indicates strong job growth, which is a positive signal for economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is increasing and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year, it indicates a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is increasing and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.
